place.raw: Watertown, Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States of America

notes: GARBLED NAME AND OMITTED FATHER (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): the documented Great Migration immigrant is 'John Whitney' (1592-1673), baptized 20 Jul 1592 at St Margaret's Westminster, son of Thomas and Mary (Bray) Whitney of Isleworth/London; emigrated 1635 on the Elizabeth and Ann; died 1 Jun 1673 Watertown, MA (Whitney Research Group/NEHGS-vetted). This record renders him 'William John James Whitney,' an invented compound given name not found in any period or compiled source, and lists only 'Lady Mary Beth Bray of Lambert Marsh' (I182587612563) as parent, omitting his father Thomas Whitney entirely. — Whitney Research Group: Family of John Whitney (1592-1673); FamilySearch: John Whitney Sr.
